GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Little Slow Out Not Bustled Settled Down 5th 6 Lengths Good Pace on with 1st following 2 Lengths behind, Under Pressure x 500m clear run home Outside had its chance but couldn't quicken - # couldn't finish off
Jumped Ok Took sit 4th Inside 4 Lengths enjoyed good trail railed within 2 Lengths Straightening Up off Inside x 200m 1 Lengths Soon After on terms, Kept Trying (b/ag w/off) # had its chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After having some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the home straight, then when endeavouring to improve near the 300m, made slight contact with another runner and as a result of this contact, became unbalanced, shifted out and made further contact with that runner. Approaching the 100m laid in and when being corrected rdr momentarily lost the use of his near-side rein.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 6l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3l off, kept on one pace # held ground

Jumped Ok Restrained Settled Down rear Outside 7 Lengths off leader/winner too much to do from there, Clear All The Way asked to go at the 400m Kept Coming Closest on line, Sound Effort - # sat too far back
Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 7th Inside 5 Lengths off leader/winner Ridden Along x 400m 4 Lengths , Couldn'T Go On x 300m, # weak final 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 800m brushed the running rail. Rdr reported after travelling satisfactorily, the gelding commenced to lose ground prior to straightening before weakening in the home straight, and added on pulling up it made a respiratory noise and may have got its tongue back. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Co-tnr subsequently reported although the gelding was found to have sustained a minor laceration to a hind leg, no other abnormalities had been identified which might explain its disappointing performance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 4th Outside 5 Lengths enjoyed good trail 1x1 600 3 Lengths , clear run home Outside loomed @ 200m, Kept Trying had its chance - # had all favours
Jumped Ok Not Bustled Went Forward sat 2nd Outside 1 Lengths off leader/winner Under Pressure Turning for home Just Kept Going One Pace couldn't finish off - # stalked winner
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re riding approaching the 200m and the circumstances that led to a rnr obtaining a run to his inside, rdr std in early part of straight his mnt was laying in and when another rnr commenced to improve close to heels it shifted out and made slight contact with his mnt. He said for this reason he directed his mnt out so that he could keep it balanced and be fully tested.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok comf Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear allowed to dictate terms own terms, challenged Turning for home again led 1 Lengths x 200m, and Kept Running - # dictated, sound

Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 5th Inside 3 Lengths 6th x 800 4 Lengths off leader/winner , Under Pressure Turning for home kept trying without threatening to win, grab 3rd on line (b/off, w/1st) # no threat 1,2
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After arriving behind the barriers was found to have an abrasion to the near-hind leg. The gelding underwent a veterinary examination and was passed suitable to race.
